title: Nutty Velvety Syrian Apples Grill
description: A comforting Syrian dish featuring grilled bramley apples with a nutty, velvety texture. Serve warm, garnished with fresh parsley.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (375°F).
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, honey, and cinnamon.
Add the halved apples to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the honey and spice mixture.
Remove the apples from the bowl and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Grill the apples for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
Transfer the grilled apples to a serving dish and drizzle with the reserved honey and spice mixture.
Sprinkle the chopped almonds over the top of the apples and serve warm.
Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
Refrigerate leftover apples for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
